_comment: Generated by Tools/terrain/strongholds.mjs (edit the script, not this file). The NPC strongholds on the Old Island (Aaron 11-16, r-siege-pve and q-stronghold-garrison; WRStronghold.cpp, WRGarrison.cpp; cooks/build-wild-strongholds.md): Elden-Ring-style forts of the game's own build pieces (the bailey of wood, the keep and the inner ward of the land's building set) that anyone may break on any world (PvE too), held by a garrison in three tiers. Positions in game cm (L_Island: +x east, +y south). Pieces: z is where the piece stands (the ground, or the keep/ward floor + its storey); embed: stands into the ground; inward: a barred door that opens from inside (gate, postern), its way in; turret: a bolt turret rides its deck. Roles: gate, palisade, tower, outpost, walk, walk_post, keep_floor, keep_wall, keep_door (the war chest opens once it or a keep wall falls), keep_stairs, keep_upper, keep_roof, keep_stair_out, beacon (lit while the fort is held), banner (down once it's taken), war_chest, ward_floor, ward_wall, ward_decor, postern, hall, decor. ladders: fixed ladders (foot, yaw toward the climber, length, lean; against = the piece index they lean on). garrison: the soldiers (rank, post, route, weapon, shield, bow, armour head/chest/hands/legs, sex, face, build; warlord = its warlords row). hounds: the land's beasts kennelled at a spot. ranks: each rank's numbers. warlords: each warlord's numbers and moves (CAL 1.13 rows: shape cone/self/line/target/throw, range, size, windup, hold, active, punish, dmg, poise, impact, flags, phase/maxPhase, weights close/mid/far, clip = the hero clip it plays). chest: what the war chest holds, refilled when the fort rebuilds. All first drafts.

forts.name: Emberwatch
forts.lore: The Forge-wardens' watch over the Ash Plains, raised when the smiths still kept the Slag Light. The Cinder Reavers hold it now, forge-hands who stayed when the wardens left and took to raiding the coast camps. Their Reeve keeps the inner ward.

forts.name: Rimehold
forts.lore: The whalers' winter fort on the Snow Flats. When the sledges stopped coming the whalers stayed and turned wrecker; the Rime Wreckers hold it still, and their Wreck-Queen keeps the inner ward.
